change: Validate each partial Arena round before sealing its actions, using the same engine rules as a complete round.

reproduction.scope: Existing controller submission logic extracted into ArenaMatchRound before adding partial-round validation.

regressions: Reject x/y bounds, unit-budget and nonadjacent claims before saving; allow a valid retry.
Reload a partial round from disk, reject an invalid action without changing bytes, complete the round and verify replay.
Include already sealed teammates in aggregate unit spending validation.
Preserve other players' commitments when the final action is invalid and permit a retry.
Reject new pending actions after match completion.
Reject observer, impersonation and duplicate submissions without changing the saved session.
Validation neither advances the clock, spends units nor changes state or replay commitments.
Reject duplicate or unrostered actors in the engine partial-round API.
